non_conclusions: The rejected b088fd13 full Chinese treatment is not reclassified as a quality win.
M8-D or M8-M does not prove the fact-gap candidate better, worse or equivalent.
M5-A does not prove broad coding superiority, every repository or every current dynamic prompt block.
M6-A is mechanism evidence, not Writer benefit evidence.
Closing V15 does not make Auto the default or admit any new model-visible optimization.
No Anthropic, retired alias, FIM, LLM router, Provider, prompt mode, compatibility layer, second Runtime or second Store is introduced.
